command.name: FindIssues
command.description: Find issues and vulnerabilities in specified files without making any edits.

steps.step: Scan all the Python files (`.py` files) in the `python` directory in the project root directory.
For each scanned file, identify any issues or vulnerabilities present.
For each identified issue, compare it against the relevant documents (if exist) to determine if it is intentional or unintentional.
